trackpadFix.reproducedBeforeFix: Three regression cases failed: repeated same-direction strokes in momentum, reversal without idle, and an idle timer that settled visuals without resetting the committed flag.
trackpadFix.cause: Every horizontal momentum event refreshed the lock timestamp. Idle only reset the transform. Fresh strokes before a 220ms gap were ignored.

Subpixel momentum does not extend the lock.
Renewed acceleration after decay and deliberate reversal can start a fresh stroke without waiting for idle.
Vertical/zoom input resets stale wheel state without canceling native behavior.
A released pending mouse pointer no longer blocks subsequent wheel input.
